nodes.label: hero.png (Vite starter isometric layer graphic, unused)
nodes.description: Isometric illustration of two stacked rounded-square platforms: a white outlined top slab floating above a base slab with a glossy purple/violet edge, joined by dashed guide lines. This is the create-vite React template's hero base image, not a Boxy brand/landing-page graphic.
nodes.rationale: Leftover from the Vite scaffold: nothing in apps/web/src imports hero.png; it sits beside the template's react.svg and vite.svg (also unreferenced), and its only styling is the template's .hero/.base/.framework/.vite rules in App.css, which no file imports. LandingPage's own Hero section does not use it. Safe candidate for cleanup.

nodes.label: Vite starter template leftovers (unused scaffold assets)
nodes.rationale: create-vite React template ships src/assets/{hero.png,react.svg,vite.svg} plus App.css .hero/.counter rules for its demo page; Boxy replaced the demo App with its own routes but never removed these files, so they are dead assets in the web bundle source tree.
